title: Crisis Communication Skills
overview: This course offers participants the chance to recognize the impact of a crisis on an organization and how to minimize its consequences. It emphasizes preparing the communication function to swiftly and efficiently respond to a crisis, enabling the management of perceptions in the media and online. By attending, you will gain insights into best practices for crisis communication management, conducting situation analyses, assessing risks, forming and assigning responsibilities to crisis teams, establishing protocols, and utilizing resources such as crisis manuals and communication tools
audience: This course is designed for team leaders, supervisors, and managers in public relations, as well as any staff member involved in managing communication issues during a crisis
methodology: The workshop is crafted to be interactive and participatory, incorporating various educational and training tools. Real-life cases will be utilized to assist participants in applying theory to practical situations effectively and efficiently
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify different types of crises and their aspects
List various principles of crisis communication
Develop crisis management processes to mitigate potential crises in their organizations
Demonstrate the benefits of using the media in a crisis situation
Evaluate and prioritize dimensions involved in crisis communication management
Analyze and interpret results achieved through crisis communication management
